unit.why: A single narrative: at the Sabbath table in Lizhensk, R. Menahem Mendel of Rymanów's cry over an overturned soup bowl is explained by his master as a sign of his hidden spiritual sight.
unit.boundary_note: Division ends with the heading of the next tale ('פ״א מהה"ק ר׳ מנחם מענדיל מרימאנוב זצ״ל'), which belongs to the following division.

stories.start_quote: מהה״ק ר׳ מנחם מענדיל מרימאנוב זצ״ל. מדי
stories.end_quote: חשבתי לו כי אני פה בליזענסק
stories.summary_en: As a young man in Lizhensk, R. Menahem Mendel of Rymanów cries out that they will all be imprisoned when his master, rapt in devekut, overturns the soup bowl on Shabbat. The crowd mocks him, but the master reveals that the act made a Viennese minister spill ink over his anti-Jewish decree, and that the youth had seen it.
